name: interlace-image
description: Dependency manifest for the published interlace Docker image. Lives here (not inlined in the Dockerfile) so the tree it installs is captured by a committed package-lock.json and installed with `npm ci` — integrity-hashed, reproducible, and what Scorecard's PinnedDependenciesID asks for. Bump a version here and regenerate the lockfile with: npm install --package-lock-only --prefix docker/image
